关于我被学姐捡回家当女友这件事

name: Guānyú Wǒ Bèi Xuéjiě Jiǎn Huí Jiā Dāng Nǚyǒu Zhè Jiàn Shì
storyline:
“Bang—!”

Tenna, a girl who has just arrived in the big city, barely has time to feel the warmth of this land of opportunity before crashing headfirst into the harshness of reality.

In her moment of despair, the one who reaches out to help her…

…is a senpai who appears like an angel — Natsu.

“Are you okay?!”

A single act of kindness.
An unexpected connection between girls from the same hometown…

“Meeting Senpai Natsu… it must be fate…! (✧ω✧)”

But after that fleeting warmth comes a cold, unforgiving bank notification:

【Account Transfer -150,000 ￥】

What is the truth behind this enormous debt?

Will you confront your senpai and demand answers…
or simply accept your fate?

And thus begins a light yuri story of two girls living together and supporting one another — sparked by a single “debt”!

“Th-That’s not true! We’re not in that kind of relationship…
…probably? (✧ω✧)”
summary: Set in Hoshino City, a modern metropolis, you play as a runaway girl rescued by a reliable senpai, leading to an unexpected life together. A light yuri visual novel with branching choices that shape the relationship and lead to multiple endings. ~60–80k words, 2–3 hours playtime.
